newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Uniwear says acquisition news likely.
newsitem.headline: Uniwear says acquisition news likely.

text.p: Belgian textile holding company Uniwear said on Wednesday it would likely announce an acquisition at the presentation of annual results on April 28.

"By the date of the announcement of the figures at the end of the month we can probably announce our next step," Uniwear finance director Yves De Poorter told a news conference on the results of a 288 million Belgian franc capital increase that closed last week.
De Poorter said the acquisition would be paid for by part of the funds raised by the share issue. He gave no details.
